author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೆಲವರಿಗೆ ಹಲವರಲಿ ದೋಷಗಳೆ ಕಾಣುವವು
ಹಲುಬದಿರೆ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಂತಿ ನೆಲೆಸುವುದು
ಹಲವಾರು ಗುಣಗಳಿವೆ ಹೊರದೂಡೆ ದೋಷಗಳ
ಬಲ್ಲವನೆ ನೀನಾಗು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Some see only faults in many people;
if you do not grumble, peace settles in the mind;
there are many good qualities once faults are pushed out;
become one who truly knows, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Fault-finding brings no peace. Look for the good in people, let go of complaint, and wisdom and calm follow.
